profile.headline: Senior iOS Software Engineer II
profile.summary: Senior iOS engineer with 10+ years of experience building and scaling high-impact mobile platforms used by millions of users. Proven track record leading modular architecture initiatives across multi-app ecosystems, improving developer velocity, and delivering user-facing features that drive engagement and business outcomes. Strong product mindset with deep expertise in Swift, SwiftUI, and platform-level engineering.

positions.title: Senior iOS Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Led development of a modular, platform-agnostic social feature deployed across Match Group apps, improving feature rollout speed by ~40% and enabling consistent UI/UX across brands

Architected a scalable networking layer using OpenAPI-generated clients, reducing integration errors and improving API reliability across multiple applications

Defined and implemented a shared package-based architecture, increasing code reuse across apps and significantly reducing duplicated logic across the ecosystem

Collaborated cross-functionally with product and design to deliver high-impact features to a large-scale user base (millions of active users)

positions.title: Sr iOS Engineer
positions.description:
Owned development and launch of Stir, a new dating app, taking it from concept to production and supporting rapid post-launch iteration

Led platform-wide modularization across multiple apps (Match, Stir, BlackPeopleMeet, OurTime), improving developer velocity and enabling shared feature delivery across brands

Revamped CI/CD pipelines using Fastlane and optimized build infrastructure, reducing build and deployment times by ~30–50% and improving team productivity

Drove adoption of Swift Package Manager to standardize dependency management and modernize legacy codebases

Influenced engineering culture through technical presentations and knowledge sharing, improving team alignment on architecture and best practices

positions.title: Senior iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led migration of 1000+ mobile apps to scalable distribution infrastructure across iOS and Android, improving
maintainability and deployment consistency

Designed dynamic app configuration systems enabling branded experiences across a large client base
 
Delivered features improving user acquisition and onboarding through customized distribution flows

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sole iOS engineer responsible for end-to-end development of the RealSavvy app, shipping 50+ releases over 2.5 years

Implemented deep linking, universal links, and real-time alerting systems to improve user engagement and retention

Maintained high app stability across iOS versions while proactively addressing deprecated APIs and performance issues

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer
positions.description: Delivered client-focused features across various apps, implementing advanced Core Data models and GCD for camera and video functionalities.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Contributed to the initial version of the app, incorporating offline features and caching to enhance usability for car sales professionals.

positions.title: Backup Technician II - Internship II Extension
positions.description:
- Work customer tickets through internal ticketing system Zendesk
- Assist customers through tickets, chats, and phone calls
- Troubleshoot software errors with Jungle Disk
- Use internal Rackspace Jungle Disk user account system to perform account management

positions.title: Software Developer - Intern II
positions.description:
- Refactored and reverse engineered broken or malfunctioning Ruby on Rails apps  
- Worked on building dynamic iOS apps with custom PHP/MySQL backends

positions.title: Help Desk Technician - Intern I
positions.description:
- Worked with Active Directory, VOIP, Intranet system, ticketing system, Oracle, permission settings, inventory management, printer configuration and management, network configurations, hardware management upgrades and installations, software upgrades and installations 
- Independently worked on onboarding each new hire and issued the workstation equipment necessary to be successful

projects.title: SocialSell  - Buy & Sell Locally, Share Information
projects.description:
SocialSell is an iOS app, Android app, and website which competes against Craigslist and Nextdoor which has an Instagram style UI/UX. I am the Founder and lead developer for SocialSell.

iOS App Link: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/socialsell-buy-sell-locally/id903735904?mt=8
Android App Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.appdifi.socialsell
Amazon App Link: http://www.amazon.com/SocialSell-LLC-Buy-Sell-Locally/dp/B00UKQ5WF2/ref=sr_1_1?s=mobile-apps&ie=UTF8&qid=1426254623&sr=1-1&keywords=socialsell
Website: http://www.socialsellsite.com/
Press: http://www.apppicker.com/reviews/18654/SocialSell-app-review-a-source-of-local-ads
Press: http://www.bizjournals.com/sanantonio/print-edition/2014/10/24/geekdom-corner.html
Twitter: https://twitter.com/thesocialsell
